title: Construction library for the thermal model (R-001, RESEARCHER, 2026-10-12)
read_me: Units: U in W/m2K (whole element, air films included); kappa = areal heat capacity in kJ/m2K; time_lag_h in hours; decrement f = 0..1 (1 = no damping).

kappa_total = sum(rho*c*d) over all layers.  kappa_int = the INTERNAL areal heat capacity the room sees (ISO 13786 / ISO 13790 12.3.1): layers on the room side of the main insulation, counted to at most 100 mm (or half the element) from the inside surface.  kappa_int drives C_m and A_m in the 5R1C model; kappa_total does not.

mass_position: none | outside (mass outside the insulation, e.g. brick veneer) | inside (mass on the room side, e.g. reverse brick veneer) | through (homogeneous massive element) | both (mass on both sides of insulation).

layers: list from OUTSIDE to INSIDE as [material_id, thickness_m]; 'R:<value>' = a pure resistance layer (air cavity, batt given by its R).  The MODELER should recompute U (ISO 6946 simple layers + framing fraction) and kappa_int / f / lag (ISO 13786 transfer-matrix) from these layers; the numbers below are the anchors to test that code against.

status per value: 'cited' = from the source given; 'calc' = layer calculation here (inputs in 'materials'); 'est' = researcher's estimate (semi-infinite periodic approximation lag = (d/delta)*24/(2*pi), delta = sqrt(alpha*86400/pi), checked against Your Home's table within ~25 %) - replace by the ISO 13786 result.
Framed walls: U uses parallel paths with 12 % timber framing; steel framing uses ~50 % batt effectiveness (est).

Ground floors: U depends on B' = A / (0.5 * perimeter) (ISO 13370).  Values given for B' = 8 m (Felix's 247 m2 room) and B' = 4 m (a small house); the engine default u_floor 0.85 matches B' ~ 4 m uninsulated.

Sources are listed in THERMAL_RESEARCH.md section 9; short keys used here: YH-PH (Your Home passive heating lag table, Baggs et al. 2009), GS (GreenSpec decrement delay), UoN (Univ. of Newcastle test modules, Sugo/Page/Moghtaderi), NCC16 (NCC 2016 Vol 2 worst-case glazing values), NCC-CAT (insulation catalogue quoting NCC zone 5 total R), HEBEL (CSR Hebel PowerPanel data), HEMP (hemp-lime study PMC7664188), RE (rammed earth 12-soil study), STRAW (straw bale lab conductivity), ISO13790 (mass classes, as in building_energy.MASS_CLASSES).

aac.note: Hebel-type AAC; panel R 0.313 per 50 mm (HEBEL) -> lambda ~0.16; AAC 0.07-0.2 for rho 300-750

cm_per_floor_est_method: C_m/A_f ~= kappa_floor(exposed share) + 0.8*kappa_int_wall + kappa_int_ceiling + 1.2*kappa_partition (plasterboard stud 9, masonry 155, AAC 66, CLT 60); rough, for sanity checks only - the model computes C_m = sum(A_j*kappa_int_j) and A_m = C_m^2 / sum(A_j*kappa_int_j^2) from the real areas.
